purpose: Grade a separately produced blind-extractor candidate against the frozen source-only reference after the candidate is materialized into an isolated adjudicator bundle.

source_unit_manifest.purpose: Finite public case-scoped quote intervals required by the canonicalizer and grader; it contains no accepted relation or annotation payload.

inputs.portable_packet_projection: Materialization copies verifier source packets as deterministic JSON projections. Canonical relative source identities and source digests remain bound in adjudicator-packet-projection-manifest.json; every absolute POSIX or Windows host-local path string is replaced with <host-local-path-redacted>.

controls.purpose: Deterministic full-trace controls, including malformed-candidate cases, supplied only to the adjudicator.

integrity.purpose: Validate the emitted bundle's closed digest inventory and retain the corpus package-byte provenance.

inputs.candidate: A fresh blind extractor must produce and freeze this complete-trace candidate before adjudication. The materialized adjudicator bundle copies it as candidate/candidate.json and records its SHA-256 in bundle-manifest.json.

required_checks: Run the commands declared in bundle-commands.json, or the materializer --check command; both validate the emitted closed inventory, each declared dependency, and the bundle-relative commands.
Run the candidate-grade command against candidate.json with source-replay; require zero canonicalization failures, missed, false, and source replay failures in every row before claiming acceptance.
Run the control-self-check command; it must reject every tracked negative control, including missing field, wrong case id, and no-span candidates.
Run record-integrity validation after final corpus package bytes are fixed and bind its package_root_sha256 in a separately authored verifier receipt.
receipt_requirements: Identify the fresh blind-producer bundle, producer context, and adjudicator bundle candidate digest.
Record exact command, stdout, stderr, and exit status for candidate grade, control self-check, and integrity validation.
State only the source-only complete-trace result; do not claim runtime behavior, architecture selection, or publication closure.
